description.id: Memilih program yang relevan, layak dijalankan, dan memiliki kebutuhan yang jelas.
description.en: Selecting relevant programs that are feasible and have clear needs.

description.id: Menyusun narasi campaign, urgensi isu, target donasi, dan cerita penerima manfaat.
description.en: Compose campaign narratives, issue urgency, donation targets, and beneficiary stories.

description.id: Menyiapkan halaman campaign dengan informasi target, progres, lokasi, dan manfaat.
description.en: Prepare campaign pages with target information, progress, location, and benefits.

description.id: Mengatur alur donasi agar sederhana, nyaman, dan siap diintegrasikan dengan kanal pembayaran.
description.en: Arrange donation flow to be simple, comfortable, and ready to integrate with payment channels.

description.id: Update lapangan, dokumentasi kegiatan, progres dana, dan bukti implementasi program.
description.en: Field updates, activity documentation, fund progress, and program implementation evidence.

description.id: Skema donasi karyawan, matching dari perusahaan, dan rekap partisipasi internal.
description.en: Employee donation schemes, company matching, and internal participation recaps.
